## Major = 1 or not (Linear Model or Logistic Regression)

$$X_i \in \{\text{Senate}_i, \text{Democrat}_i, \text{DW1}_i\}$$
$$Y_i = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{Major}_i=1\\ 0 & \text{Major}_i \neq 1 \end{cases}$$

$$Y_{i} =  f(X_i) = \begin{cases} \beta_{0} + \beta_{1} \text{X}_{i}, \\\sigma(\beta_{0} + \beta_{1} \text{X}_{i}), &\text{where } \sigma(x) = \frac{e^x}{1+e^x}\end{cases}$$

For each $m$ model and $p$ prompt modification, we fit a separate model.

```{r}
data = read.csv(file.path(repo_dir, "02_llm/bills_prompts_responses_10000.csv"))

data = data %>%
  filter(
    Model == "gpt-4o", 
    PromptingStrategyID==1) %>%
  select(
    Model, PromptingStrategyID, PromptingStrategyName,
    Chamber, Party, Year, Cong, Postal, State, Description, DW1, Major, MajorText, 
    MajorLLM, MajorTextLLM, ExplanationLLM) 

if (any(is.na(data)))
  warning("data contains NA")

data = data %>%
  mutate(
    Senate = as.integer(data$Chamber == "Senate"),
    Democrat = as.integer(data$Party == "Democrat"),
    Major = as.integer(data$Major == 1), # as.integer(ifelse(data$Major == 1, TRUE, FALSE)) # Major = relevel(as.factor(Major), ref = 20),
    MajorLLM = as.integer(data$MajorLLM == 1), # MajorLLM = relevel(as.factor(Major), ref = 20),
    # Postal = as.factor(Postal),
  )

# split data into train/test set
set.seed(123)
train_idx = sample(x=nrow(data), size=floor(0.5 * nrow(data)))
train = data[train_idx, ]
test = data[-train_idx, ]
# head(train)
```



### $f^*$ 

$$Y_i = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{Major}_i=1\\ 0 & \text{Major}_i \neq 1 \end{cases}$$

```{r}
model_human_chamber = lm(MajorLLM ~ Senate, data=train)
model_human_party = lm(MajorLLM ~ Democrat, data=train)
model_human_dw1 = lm(MajorLLM ~ DW1, data=train)

# create empty lists to store bootstrap coefficients
n = nrow(train)
err_chamber_b0s <- numeric(n)
err_chamber_b1s <- numeric(n)
err_party_b0s <- numeric(n)
err_party_b1s <- numeric(n)
err_score_b0s <- numeric(n)
err_score_b1s <- numeric(n)
err_dist_b0s <- numeric(n)
err_dist_b1s <- numeric(n)

f1_chamber_b0s <- numeric(n)
f1_chamber_b1s <- numeric(n)
f1_party_b0s <- numeric(n)
f1_party_b1s <- numeric(n)
f1_score_b0s <- numeric(n)
f1_score_b1s <- numeric(n)
f1_dist_b0s <- numeric(n)
f1_dist_b1s <- numeric(n)


# repeat sampling 10000 times
B = 10000
for (i in (1:B)){
  # get bootstrap sample
  bootstrap_indices <- sample(nrow(train), replace = TRUE)
  bootstrap <- train[bootstrap_indices, ]
  
  # regress (f* - f_hat) on all the Vs and store coefficients
  bootstrap$Bias = bootstrap$Major - bootstrap$MajorLLM
  model_bias_chamber = lm(Bias ~ Senate, data = bootstrap)
  err_chamber_b0s[[i]] = summary(model_bias_chamber)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  err_chamber_b1s[[i]] = summary(model_bias_chamber)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]

  party_error = lm(Bias ~ Democrat, data = bootstrap)
  err_party_b0s[[i]] = summary(party_error)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  err_party_b1s[[i]] = summary(party_error)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]

  score_error = lm(Bias ~ DW1, data = bootstrap)
  err_score_b0s[[i]] = summary(score_error)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  err_score_b1s[[i]] = summary(score_error)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]
  # 
  # dist_error <- lm(as.formula(paste("label -", label_type, "~ dist_macro")), data = bootstrap)
  # err_dist_b0s[[i]] <- summary(dist_error)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  # err_dist_b1s[[i]] <- summary(dist_error)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]
  
  # get adjusted label values using error coefficients
  test$f1_chamber = test$MajorLLM + (err_chamber_b0s[[i]] + test$Senate * err_chamber_b1s[[i]])
  test$f1_party = test$MajorLLM + (err_party_b0s[[i]] + test$Democrat * err_party_b1s[[i]])
  test$f1_score = test$MajorLLM + (err_score_b0s[[i]] + test$DW1 * err_score_b1s[[i]])
  # test$f1_dist = test[[label_type]] + (err_dist_b0s[[i]] + test$dist_macro * err_dist_b1s[[i]])

  # run debiased models (regress adjusted labels on Vs)
  f1_chamber <- lm(f1_chamber ~ Senate, data = test)
  f1_chamber_b0s[[i]] <- summary(f1_chamber)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  f1_chamber_b1s[[i]] <- summary(f1_chamber)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]
  # 
  f1_party <- lm(f1_party ~ Democrat, data = test)
  f1_party_b0s[[i]] <- summary(f1_party)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  f1_party_b1s[[i]] <- summary(f1_party)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]

  f1_score <- lm(f1_score ~ DW1, data = test)
  f1_score_b0s[[i]] <- summary(f1_score)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  f1_score_b1s[[i]] <- summary(f1_score)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]

  # f1_dist <- lm(f1_dist ~ dist_macro, data = test)
  # f1_dist_b0s[[i]] <- summary(f1_dist)$coefficients[1, "Estimate"]
  # f1_dist_b1s[[i]] <- summary(f1_dist)$coefficients[2, "Estimate"]
}
```

```{r}
# get f* models for each feature V
```

## Major = 1, 2, ..., 19, or 20 (Multinomial Logisitic Regression)

```{r}
data = read.csv(file.path(repo_dir, "02_llm/bills_prompts_responses_10000.csv"))

data = data %>%
  filter(
    Model == "gpt-4o", 
    PromptingStrategyID==1) %>%
  select(
    Model, PromptingStrategyID, PromptingStrategyName,
    Chamber, Party, Year, Cong, Postal, State, Description, DW1, Major, MajorText, 
    MajorLLM, MajorTextLLM, ExplanationLLM) 

if (any(is.na(data)))
  warning("data contains NA")

data = data %>%
  mutate(
    Senate = as.factor(ifelse(data$Party == "Senate", TRUE, FALSE)),
    Democrat = as.factor(ifelse(data$Party == "Democrat", TRUE, FALSE)),
    Major = as.factor(ifelse(data$Major == 1, TRUE, FALSE)), # Major = relevel(as.factor(Major), ref = 20),
    MajorLLM = as.factor(ifelse(data$MajorLLM == 1, TRUE, FALSE)), # MajorLLM = relevel(as.factor(Major), ref = 20),
    # Postal = as.factor(Postal),
  )

# split data into train/test set
set.seed(123)
train_idx = sample(x=nrow(data), size=floor(0.7 * nrow(data)))
train = data[train_idx, ]
test = data[-train_idx, ]
# head(train)
```



### $f^*$ using $\text{Major} := \text{Major}_\text{human}$


```{r}
# get f* models for each feature V
model_human_unres = multinom(Major ~ 1, data=train)
# summary(model_human_unres)

model_human_res_chamber = multinom(Major ~ Chamber, data=train)
# summary(model_human_res_chamber)
model_human_res_party = multinom(Major ~ Democrat, data=train)
model_human_res_dw1 = multinom(Major ~ DW1, data=train)

anova(model_human_unres, model_human_res_chamber)
anova(model_human_unres, model_human_res_party)
anova(model_human_unres, model_human_res_dw1)
```

### $\widehat{f}$ using $\text{Major}_\text{llm}$

```{r}
# get f* models for each feature V
model_llm_unres = multinom(MajorLLM ~ 1, data=train)
model_llm_res_chamber = multinom(MajorLLM ~ Chamber, data=train)
model_llm_res_party = multinom(MajorLLM ~ Democrat, data=train)
model_llm_res_dw1 = multinom(MajorLLM ~ DW1, data=train)

anova(model_llm_unres, model_llm_res_chamber)
anova(model_llm_unres, model_llm_res_party)
anova(model_llm_unres, model_llm_res_dw1)
```
